director.name: 约翰·D·鲍斯韦尔 John D. Boswell

this_title: LIFE BEYOND: Visions of Alien Life
introduction: Two possibilites exist: either we are alone in the universe, or we are not. Both are equally terrifying.Are we alone? What might alien species look like? And what could we learn from them? Proudly presenting Life Beyond Remastered, a film that weaves all 3 episodes of the series together with new content and updated visuals & audio into a feature-length experience.
